title: Reconcile CLI streaming claim with implementation
description: Review finding from loreweaver-1ek. ADR 0002 says Stage 1 CLI includes streaming, but ModelClient.complete returns whole responses and CLI writes narration only after completion. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: Either streaming support is implemented and tested through the model/client/CLI path, or docs/ADR follow-up clarifies that Stage 1 currently uses whole-response turn output.
notes: Resolved via PR #57 (https://github.com/jbongaarts/loreweaver/pull/57). Took the docs path from the acceptance criteria: ADR 0002 Stage 1 now states whole-response turn output explicitly, names token-level streaming as additive ModelClient work behind its own ADR, and the misleading 'Stream the DM's narration' CLI comment is updated. Typecheck and full test suite pass (404 passed, 2 documented skips).
close_reason: Merged via PR #57 (squash 05cff75..e9b0d48 on main). ADR 0002 Stage 1 now states whole-response turn-granular output explicitly; token-level streaming framed as additive ModelClient capability behind its own ADR. Misleading CLI comment updated. Flaky-vitest-timeout follow-up filed as loreweaver-6tn.
